MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The aluminum foil tape feels like a useful next choice because it could seal duct connections alongside the duct clamps I bought most recently.",
    "The heat shrink tubing complements my earlier wire connectors by protecting connections rather than simply giving me more connectors.",
    "The removable fasteners and waterproof connectors fit my practical repair interests, although I would wait for a specific task before choosing them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The washers and battery lugs require particular sizes and applications that my purchases do not establish a need for.",
    "Painting tape and O-ring lubricant serve different tasks from the repairs suggested by my history; buying tape or clamps does not mean I need every related maintenance supply.",
    "The cups repeat an earlier purchase without a reason to replenish them, while ten tubes of super glue and a full case of painting tape exceed any need I currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of adhesives and repair tape seem to have been taken as interest in tape and glue regardless of their purpose or quantity.",
    "My connector and clamp purchases seem to have been stretched into assumed needs for heavy battery wiring and seal maintenance."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent duct clamps make supplies for sealing duct connections more relevant to me now than supplies for unrelated repairs.",
    "A useful addition to something I own is more compelling than another assortment that does much the same job.",
    "I choose supplies when their function, dimensions, and quantity fit a concrete task; general repair usefulness alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests, but the strongest matches support a plausible next task rather than merely resembling something I bought."
}
